title: Multi-plate camera gantry concept
text: The September group discussion describes one camera moving above multiple plates on an interval schedule, with the incubation region centrally located and electronics below. This is a separate research configuration from the earlier single-plate enclosure drawings. [S27][S28]

A proposed XY carriage would associate each tray position with a registered plate ID and repeatable imaging pose. Design work includes homing, collision limits, cable routing, positional repeatability, exposure timing and condensation management. Acquisition should occur only after motion settles.

Validation must measure image-scale changes across the travel range, focus variation, vibration and registration errors. A multi-plate layout increases capacity only if incubation uniformity, optical calibration and scheduling remain acceptable. No throughput or cost target is confirmed.
